notes: Designed executable runtime semantics for catalog-named P-ids. Not transcribed from 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.json (absent).

protocols.anonymity_lift_meaning: First authorized public binding of seat_token to seat_id, immediately after RESULT_FREEZE. There is no discussion phase; conversational and estimate anonymity share this clock.

leaks_before_lift.why: a unique stylistic marker in a forwarded comment binds the sealed estimate to one seat

leaks_before_lift.carrier: tool_run_id on the public SUBMIT view
leaks_before_lift.why: a unique tool invocation id is a runtime identity even when seat_id is stripped

leaks_before_lift.carrier: public submit_delay_ms unique to one seat
leaks_before_lift.why: a delay no other seat shares identifies the remaining participant

protocols.anonymity_lift_meaning: Estimate-attribution anonymity lifts at UNSEAL after RESULT_FREEZE. Conversational anonymity is not provided after DISCUSSION_OPEN: speech may carry seat_id, estimates may not.

leaks_before_lift.why: naming whose number is whose during discussion unseals estimates before RESULT_FREEZE
tool provenance on the card binds the number to a runtime identity
unique submit timing identifies the card author while discussion is still open

protocols.anonymity_lift_meaning: Sheet authorship is token-sealed through six pass cycles and POOL_REVEAL. Lift is UNSEAL (plenary unseal) after the pool is published without names.

leaks_before_lift.carrier: idea text on a circulating sheet
leaks_before_lift.why: a unique phrase written in cycle 1 is still on the sheet when later seats read it

leaks_before_lift.carrier: editor session id stamped on a digital sheet cell
leaks_before_lift.why: the cell's tool_run_id names the writer without a byline
a unique pass latency identifies who held the sheet

protocols.anonymity_lift_meaning: Silent generation has no public view. POOL_REVEAL publishes note bodies without authors. Attribution anonymity lifts at UNSEAL.

leaks_before_lift.why: the pooled text still carries a unique stylistic marker of its author
the capture tool names the writer

leaks_before_lift.carrier: public note-arrival delays during the silent window
leaks_before_lift.why: a unique arrival time identifies the remaining silent seat

protocols.anonymity_lift_meaning: Ballots (vote + predicted popularity) stay sealed through scoring. Lift is UNSEAL immediately after SCORE_FREEZE. Revealing ballots before freeze makes Bayesian Truth Serum gameable.

leaks_before_lift.carrier: free-text justification attached to a public ballot
leaks_before_lift.why: justification stylometry identifies the voter before SCORE_FREEZE
the voting tool's run id is a seat identity

leaks_before_lift.carrier: public ballot arrival unique to one seat
leaks_before_lift.why: the last unique delay names the remaining voter while scoring is still open

protocols.anonymity_lift_meaning: Work-product authorship and reviewer identity stay sealed until SCORE_LOCK. UNSEAL is the first authorized author (and reviewer) reveal.

leaks_before_lift.why: stylometry of the artifact identifies the author before SCORE_LOCK

leaks_before_lift.carrier: paths or tool_run_id left in the artifact
leaks_before_lift.why: a unique tool trace in the work product is an author byline

leaks_before_lift.carrier: creation timestamp unique to one author seat
leaks_before_lift.why: a unique ingest time identifies the author while scores are still open
